prompt_md: A share price jumps 50% on Monday, then drops 50% on Tuesday. What percent of its starting price is it worth now?
prompt_short: Up 50%, then down 50%. Percent of the starting price?
hint_md: Start at 100 dollars and follow it day by day.
explain_intuition_md: The 50% drop is taken from the bigger, post-jump price, so it wipes out more than the jump added. 100 becomes 150, and half of 150 is 75.
